item.title: Upcoming deprecation of GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex
item.description: We will deprecate GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex across GitHub Copilot experiences, with dates that require teams to update workflows and model policies.

item.title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — April update
item.description: The April Visual Studio update centers on agentic workflows, custom agents, and a debugger agent.

item.title: Copilot Student GPT-5.3-Codex removal from model picker
item.description: GitHub removed GPT-5.3-Codex from the Copilot Student model picker while leaving it available through auto model selection.

item.title: Copilot cloud agent starts 20% faster with Actions custom images
item.description: GitHub says Copilot cloud agent sessions now start more than 20% faster because of optimized Actions custom images.

item.title: GitHub Copilot code review will start consuming GitHub Actions minutes on June 1, 2026
item.description: GitHub is warning customers ahead of a billing change: Copilot code review will consume GitHub Actions minutes starting June 1, 2026.
